$comentario: Invoices: the history and the open invoice. The printed template's text does NOT go here —it goes in documents.json— because the document's language is not the screen's language (RN-29, T-811).
invoices_description: History of the sales recorded in the system.
invoices_no_results_hint: Try other filters, or clear them to see everything.
invoices_none_hint: The sales you charge will show up here.
invoice_print_hint: The print dialog can also save it as a PDF.
invoice_annul_hint: A credit note voiding the whole document is issued, stock is restored and the amount charged is refunded. Use it when the document should not have existed: the wrong customer or type.
invoice_note_hint: Corrects what was charged without moving goods. A debit note is collected now; a credit note is refunded from the drawer. Enter each amount including tax.
invoice_note_debit_off: Debit notes are turned off in Settings.
invoice_note_reason_placeholder: Why the amount is being corrected
invoice_note_failed: The note could not be issued
amount_note_registered_debit: Debit note issued. Collect the amount from the customer.
amount_note_registered_credit: Credit note issued. Hand over the refund from the drawer.

match.reason=certificate_missing: The signing certificate for this environment is missing.
match.reason=credentials_missing: The ATV user or password is missing.
match.reason=credentials_rejected: Hacienda did not accept the ATV user or password.
match.reason=document_invalid: The document is missing data Hacienda requires.
match.reason=reception_rejected: Hacienda rejected the submission before processing it.
match.reason=forbidden: The credentials are not allowed for this issuer.
match.reason=hacienda_error: Hacienda could not process it and gave no reason.
match.reason=retries_exhausted: Tried for 72 hours without reaching Hacienda.
match.reason=no_verdict: Hacienda received it 72 hours ago and has not decided yet.

match.event=xml_lost: The signed XML was missing; signing again

invoice_file_hint: Where the document is and when each step happened. The XML you download is the one that was signed, byte for byte.
invoice_file_none: This sale has no electronic document: it was charged without electronic invoicing.
invoice_xml_pending: The XML can be downloaded once the document is signed.
invoice_response_pending: The response can be downloaded once Hacienda answers.
invoice_in_queue: Queued: the queue picks it up within seconds.
invoice_retry_hint: Puts it back in the queue after fixing what stopped it. A rejection by Hacienda is not retried: a new document is issued.
invoice_retry_done: The document is back in the queue.
invoice_events_none: Nothing yet: the queue picks it up within seconds.
invoices_stopped_hint: What the queue cannot solve on its own. Each one says why and how long it has been waiting; the deadline to transmit what was issued in contingency is about eight business days.
invoices_queue_alarm_warning: Some documents have been waiting for Hacienda for more than a day ({count} pending, the oldest from {since}). Check the connection, the certificate and the credentials under Invoices.
invoices_queue_alarm_danger: Some documents have had no answer from Hacienda for five days or more ({count} pending, the oldest from {since}). The contingency deadline is running out: deal with it today.
invoices_contingency: The business is issuing in contingency: Hacienda has not answered since the last attempt. Documents are transmitted on their own when it comes back.
